summary: Cal Fire octagonal cab on a 20 ft tower above San Luis Reservoir, Merced County; built 1947 per the Register, with a station reported in 1945; NHLR-registered 2010.

facts.design: 16 by 16 ft octagonal CalFire cab on a 20 ft enclosed tower; a 1948 clipping describes a 16-foot-square tower with a garage at ground level, living quarters above and an observation room on top

access.note: Cal Fire site with radio towers at the summit; no source says the cab is open to visitors

visit.trail_note: Rough track from San Luis Reservoir State Recreation Area up to the summit, per a Bay Area Peaks hike report

facts.agency: California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection (Cal Fire)

events.note: Aug 1945 newspaper item: a station in operation atop Basalt Hill, Vern Yarborough in charge. Not clear it is the same structure as the current tower
NHLR build field and Wikipedia's first date. A Jan 1948 clipping shows the new tower still under construction, so 1947 may be the start of work rather than completion
Forrest Eckler on the job during 1947, living in a cabin until the new tower was ready

notes_for_editor: Build date is disputed. NHLR Built field says 1947 but its description says built in the 1950s; Wikipedia says 1947 or 1945; an Aug 1945 clipping reports a station in operation on the hill; a Jan 1948 clipping says the new tower was still being built. The 1947 record is kept, not corrected. The sources suggest an earlier station existed and the current tower was finished around 1947-48, which is an inference from the clippings. Footprint disagrees: the 1948 clipping says the tower is 16 ft square, Wikipedia gives the tower as 20 by 20 ft, and the NHLR gives a 20 ft enclosed tower. height_m 6.1 uses the clipping's 20 ft platform height. Access level 'restricted' is an inference from Cal Fire administration and the radio-tower summit; no source states the cab's visitor status. Bay Area Peaks lists 'Agency: California State Parks' for the hike area, probably the reservoir SRA rather than the lookout; not used. No current staffing or condition source found; staffing is left out of facts. Wikipedia's references include a 1992 lease notice with personal contact details; not used. No photos added. One WebSearch used.
